notes.title: Version 9
notes.content:
[h1][b]Version 9[/b][/h1][p]This patch adds new Achievements, stats and Leaderboards and addresses a bug or two[/p][p][/p][h2]Leaderboards[/h2][list][*][p]Two new leaderboards for lifetime merges & drops have been added, boot up the game and play 1 match to add your entry[/p][/*][*][p]The leaderboard can be viewed from the stats page[/p][/*][/list][h2]Statistics[/h2][list][*][p]A new stat "Fruit Lost" has been added to time attack, to track how many fruit you have spilled out of the blender[/p][/*][/list][h2]Achievements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Wasteful!
[/b][i]Granted to those who waste fruit, 20 of them to be precise[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]A Bunch OF Bananas[/b]
[i]Granted to those who have proven themselves in the way of the blender. 
If you already meet the requirements booting the game should grant the achievement![/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc changes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the wrong sound effect playing in certain menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the [b]Twitch integration[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a build number & identifier to the settings menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 8
notes.content: [h1]Version 8[/h1][p]This version is another tiny patch, which addresses some issues with the match history[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could view the history while it was empty[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the display of scores in Time Attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a issue with the quota for history items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small issue related to navigating between the different menu screens[/p][/*][*][p]History items are now properly sorted on date & time again[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 7
notes.content: [h1]Version 7[/h1][p]Really small patch that does things.[/p][p][/p][p]- Shed some extra light on the blender[/p][p]- Fixed resolution not being saved & applied properly[/p][p]- Split up resolution & refresh rate dropdowns[/p][p]- Fixed quantum gaming[/p]

notes.title: Version 6
notes.content:
[h1]Version 6[/h1][p]A new version is here, once again! This version focuses on the Time Attack gamemode to hopefully make it more interesting.[/p][p][/p][h2]Time Attack Rework[/h2][list][*][p]Time attack starting time increasted from 2:00 to 3:00[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the cap on time (was 2:00)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]"pause timer" mechanic[/b], as you merge fruit this bar fills up (and slowly drains!)[/p][p]When the bar is full, it will start draining at a rapid speed
While the bar is draining, the timer does not go down[/p][/*][*][p]Removed merge time bonus for Banana, Peach, Pear & Apple[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Watermelon time bonus from 30 seconds to 1 minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Letting a fruit escape the blender no longer instantly ends the game, but instead causes you to [b]lose 10 seconds on the clock[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Time Survived is now displayed alongside the remaining time[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Hopefully these changes will make time attack a lot more interesting to play![/p][p][/p][h2]New Achievements & Stats[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new Achievement "Temporal Anomaly" for pausing time 25 times in time attack[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new stat "Times Time Frozen" to track how many times you have frozen time[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Made the gravity super fruit not attract until it is dropped[/p][/*][*][p]Made the gravity fruit's effect 4x as strong[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Time Attack in-game leaderboard to show scores in mm:ss format[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the log file to become bloated quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused unavailable UI elements to be selectable while using controller inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Storage Quota for history entries[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 3
notes.content:
[h1]Super Fruit (NEW GAMEMODE!)[/h1]
[b]Everybody makes mistakes. That's why we've invented edible* super juice. These special "fruits" can really mix things up. Drop some lead, shrink it, or defy gravity with these Super (delicious) fruits.[/b]

[h3]Super Fruit: BOUNCY[/h3]
A fruit covered in a super bouncy sauce that makes it bounce higher and faster. Be careful though, it's hard to control!

[h3]Super Fruit: GLUE COVERED[/h3]
It's covered in glue and will stick to the first fruit it touches.

[h3]Super Fruit: GRAVITY[/h3]
This fruit has a gravitational pull that will pull other fruits of the same type towards it.

[h3]Super Fruit: LEAD[/h3]
A heavy fruit that sinks straight to the bottom, where it will lose its power. Be careful, as it will try to push anything out of its way.

[h1]Super Controls[/h1]
[b]The controls on PC (Mouse/Keyboard) have been updated! The cursor will now ignore fruit and stay in place. This should allow you to be more consistent when dropping multiple fruits without moving. If you want the old way of it targeting the fruit, you can hold the "SHIFT" key.[/b]

[h1]Super Gamemode Changes![/h1]
Before, all games started with the following fruit queue: Cherry, Strawberry, Cherry, Apricot.
This has been changed to be unique per mode:

[h3]Classic Mode[/h3]
Cherry, Strawberry, Cherry, Apricot, Strawberry

[h3]Time Attack[/h3]
Strawberry, Apricot, Strawberry, Cherry, Cherry, Cherry

[h3]Auto Drop[/h3]
Apricot, Apricot, Cherry, Strawberry, Cherry, Kiwi

[h3]Super Fruit[/h3]
Cherry, Strawberry, Apricot, Apricot, Cherry (Bouncy)

Additionally, the fruit that becomes available as the game progresses has also been changed:

[h3]Classic Mode[/h3]
Cherry, Strawberry & Apricot
> 200 Score: Higher chance for Apricot
> 750 Score: Chance for Kiwi
> 1500 Score: Chance for Plum
> 2500 Score: Lowered chance for Strawberry & Cherry

[h3]Time Attack[/h3]
Cherry & Strawberry
> 30 Seconds Survived: Chance for Apricot
> 60 Seconds Survived: Chance for Kiwi
> 120 Seconds Survived: Chance for Plum

[h3]Auto Drop[/h3]
Auto drop does not change fruit over time and always has the ability to drop Cherry, Strawberry, Apricot & Kiwi

[h3]Super Fruit[/h3]
Cherry, Strawberry & Apricot
> 200 Score: Higher chance for Apricot
> 750 Score: Chance for Kiwi
> 1500 Score: Chance for Plum

[h1]Super Achievements[/h1]
[b]Super Fruit: Let's Try Again[/b] Use a Mirror fruit to re-drop a watermelon.
[b]Super Fruit: Binary Star System[/b] Have two Gravity fruits attract each other.
[b]Super Fruit: Immediate Danger[/b] Keep upgrading a bouncy fruit to end up with a bouncy peach!
[b]The Love for Three Oranges[/b] Have three oranges in play at the same time.
[b]Fruit Punch[/b] Have at least one of every fruit active at the same time!

[h1]Super Stats![/h1]
The new gamemode has its leaderboard added, and two new stats for it.

notes.title: Beta 3: Changelog
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1][list][*]Fruits are now more bouncy and move around more easily.[/*][*]Fruits receive 5x more mass when freshly dropped, It goes away the moment it impacts anything.[/*][/list][h2]Classic Mode[/h2]
The Combo Multiplier has been changed:
[list][*]Minimum decay rate changed to 4x from 1x[/*][*]Introduced a "buffer" time when you merge fruit, Pausing the combo timer. Buffer time lasts 2 seconds and is canceled if you drop fruit.[/*][/list][h2]Time Attack[/h2]
Time Attack extra time has been rebalanced, Instead of using the fruits "Value" (All of the merges together) to determine how much time to add it now uses the following:

Cherry, Strawberry & Apricot: No extra timeKiwi: +2 SecondPlum, Orange & Apple: +5 SecondsPear: +10 SecondsBanana: +30 SecondsWatermelon: +120 Seconds (Full reset)

This should incentivise going for bigger fruit over trying to spam apricot merges to extend your time.
[h1]Visual Changes[/h1][list][*]Added a little welcome jingle 🎵[/*][*]Added a animation to the "Up Next" queue to indicate changes[/*][*]Changed the splash screen[/*][*]Classic multiplier is now displayed in the top left[/*][*]The outside looks less barren.[/*][/list][h1]Statistics[/h1]
Introduced a load of new stats
[list][*]Total Score (Per Gamemode)[/*][*]Watermelons Created[/*][*]Bananas Created[/*][*]Peaches Created[/*][*]Pears Created[/*][*]Apples Created[/*][*]Oranges Created[/*][*]Plums Created[/*][*]Kiwis Created[/*][*]Apricots Created[/*][*]Strawberries Created[/*][*]Strawberries Created[/*][*]Games Played: Classic[/*][*]Games Played: Time Attack[/*][*]Games Played: Auto Drop[/*][*]Points Earned: Classic[/*][*]Seconds Survived: Time Attack[/*][*]Fruit Dropped: Time Attack[/*][/list][h1]Technical Changes[/h1][list][*]Updated directory structureThis means that some paths like logfile locations have changed, Please get in touch via Discord if this affects you! (Technical Support)[/*][/list]
